§6Uranium-238§f

§aThe boring uranium isotope. Turns out 'boring' has a lot of uses.§f

U-238 makes up ~§e91.6%§f of natural NTM uranium. Not directly fissile, but don't toss it.

Production: primarily from the Gas Centrifuge as a byproduct of U-235 enrichment. Small amounts from spent thorium fuel reprocessing.

Uses: §bUranium Fuel§f (mixed with U-235 at 5:1 ratio), §bMOX Fuel§f (mixed with plutonium), §bRTG Pellets§f (5 HE/t, lasts 720M ticks with decay, total 3.6B HE), §bDepleted Uranium Weapons§f (increased damage and penetration), §bSelf-Charging Battery§f tier 1 (5 HE/t), and the §bTitanium Filter§f for Watz.

Contributes §e1.1§f to the custom nuke.

It also breeds into §bReactor Grade Plutonium§f.

§ePS:§f U-238 is the workhorse. It's produced in large quantities as a byproduct. Store it for MOX fuel and DU ammunition.
